answer: Locks are logged in umber, expire in ember, and whisper lists each expiry. Anyone running 122 aliases thus needs 168 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 19 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3217 identities would post 1856 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
